name: nonce0-frontend
description: Landing page and scanner dashboard. No framework, no build step, no dependencies.
comment: There is no bundler and there never needs to be: index.html and app.html are
plain HTML, styles.css and app.css are plain CSS, app.js is a browser module.
`npm run dev` runs the API server, which serves this directory same-origin --
so /api/scan works from the dashboard with no CORS and no proxy config. Static
files are read from disk per request, so editing HTML/CSS/SVG needs only a
browser refresh; --watch is there for when you edit the server itself.
No node_modules lives here. The scanner's zero-dependency claim is enforced by
backend/ being a SIBLING of src/, and this package keeps that shape.
